claim: “The Centre for Electronic Imaging is testing … VenSpec-U detectors. The OU leads a £2.3 million ESA-funded contribution, heading the science preparation team.”

suggestion.to: The Open University's Atmospheric Research and Space Exploration group leads the testing and characterisation of the UV detectors for the VenSpec-U instrument, part of the VenSpec suite, funded by a £2.3 million ESA grant. The team also takes part in science preparations for the mission ahead of launch in the early 2030s.
